params.body:
## Why

Ilse (2026-09-16): "Download showroom" (Settings, Showroom) is a 500 in production. The download photographed the slide page once per vehicle in a headless Chrome (spatie/browsershot, puppeteer). That Chrome lived on the server, not in the code: Delta hard-coded Plesk's node path, and the Forge deploy removes `node_modules` after the asset build, so puppeteer and its Chrome were gone every time the button was pressed.

Decision (Shane, 2026-09-16): no browser on the server. The showroom slides were the only thing in the app that needed one.

Supersedes #496 (honest error and a Chrome status check): this PR contains that commit rebased and then replaces every Chrome piece. #496 can be closed in favour of this one.

## What changes

- `App\Support\ShowroomSlide` draws one slide as a 1920x1080 JPEG with Intervention Image on Imagick (GD when Imagick is absent, as on a developer machine), in the layout of the web slide (`ownstock/showroom_vehicle.blade.php`, R S2-7.14): black band with make and model and the dealer's name, address and logo; photo left; year, fuel and mileage right; the skewed white blocks with price (`CustomerModePrice::showroomPrice`), warranty (`Custom::extendedWarranty`, 12 months fallback, R S2-7.13) and the lease banner on the same condition as the web slide. Text in Inter (two static TTFs cut from the variable woff2 the app already ships), icons from the theme's Font Awesome TTF: rendering depends on nothing the server happens to have.
- Same file shape for the TV players: `image_{id}.jpeg`, `showroom_fotos.zip`.
- A vehicle without a price gets no price block (instead of "0 €", decided by Shane); a missing photo gets the default silhouette on a neutral light panel; a long name shrinks and then gets an ellipsis.
- `SettingsController::downloadShowroom` skips a vehicle whose slide fails and names it in the notification after the download; when nothing can be drawn the dealer gets "De download is nu niet mogelijk, de beheerder is verwittigd" and nothing is left behind.
- Removed: `spatie/browsershot` (and `spatie/temporary-directory`) from composer, `puppeteer` from package.json and lock, `App\Support\Screenshot`, `ScreenshotUnavailable`, `ScreenshotTest`, the `services.browsershot` config and `BROWSERSHOT_*` in `.env.example`. `git grep -i browsershot|puppeteer|chrome` now only hits history (dated findings, CUTOVER, the refactor log) and browser-detection code.
- Koppelingen panel and `stocklist:smoke showroom`: "Showroom-slides (Imagick)" checks the extension and the font files, cheap, no rendering.
- Showroom tab hint: "Eén zip met een JPEG (1920 x 1080) per showroomwagen, ongeveer een minuut per 100 slides" (measured about 0.5 s per slide with GD; was "+-3 minuten/100 slides"). nl/fr/en/de.
- Rule R S2-7.16 rewritten; finding `2026-09-16-showroom-download-chrome.md` rewritten (cause, decision, status opgelost); CUTOVER.md aftercare item closed ("no browser needed since 2026-09-16"); refactor log notes the removal.
- Docs (coordinator, same PR): `docs/preview.md` step 3 gets the `storage/` subfolders one-liner for a new Forge site (Forge shares `storage/` across releases, the repo does not carry the subfolders, first deploy failed in `package:discover` with "Please provide a valid cache path"); steps 5/6 now say to fill `.env` and run the first `stocklist:preview-refresh` from the release directory BEFORE the first Deploy Now, because `migrate --force` on an empty database loads the schema dump and then re-runs the old migrations ("Table 'widgets' already exists"). The same storage one-liner is in CUTOVER.md section 5b.

## Tests

- `ShowroomSlideTest` (new): a slide is a 1920x1080 JPEG with the vehicle photo drawn in it (pixel sample), a vehicle without photo still gets a slide with the placeholder, the machine check, `fit()` ellipsis, price and mileage formatting.
- `ShowroomDownloadTest`: the zip holds one real 1920x1080 JPEG per showroom vehicle with the same names and content type; empty showroom; one failing vehicle is skipped and named; nothing drawable gives the notification and no leftovers.
- `IntegrationSmokeTest`: showroom check ok, listed, label.
- Ran: ShowroomDownloadTest, ShowroomSlideTest, IntegrationSmokeTest, LanguageParityTest, RulesCoverageTest, RulesIdentityTest, CompiledViewsTest, AlpineExpressionTest, HandlerWiringTest, StylesheetSyntaxTest, BuildContractTest: 50 tests, 198 assertions, 1 incomplete (pre-existing). SmokeTest filtered on settings passes; its three `ownvehicle.edit` failures locally are the missing `public/js/vehicle/create.js` build in the worktree, unrelated.

## Visual check

Three slides rendered from the demo dataset (GD) next to a Playwright screenshot of the web slide for the same vehicle; layout, order of the bottom blocks (lease, warranty, price, stripes from the right, as the floats render) and text sizes match. Screenshots in the agent's scratchpad, listed in the report.
params.title: Showroom download draws the slides in PHP; no browser on the server any more
